title: Read a name from a path
summary: Flask: Read a name from a path. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: Angle brackets mark a path input. GET /hello/Ravi passes Ravi to the function.
learningObjectives: Read a name from a path with Flask

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.
Read a name from a path

blocks.title: Read a name from a path

blocks.text: The path placeholder becomes the Python name input. Ravi is inserted into the greeting.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A path value is untrusted input; do not paste it into raw HTML.
